items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] John McMurray probably used that, didn't they? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. Uh, how long had, uh, Cuckoo been playing? Do you remember how long Cuckoo had been playing? Oh, Talbot was playing a long time before I met him.

Yeah. Yeah. Because I saw him several times on that Voilishman's. Uh, playing for different dancers. Mm-hmm. He'd even sing on that truck without a mic. Yeah. Oh, man. Yeah, that was long before he had started playing with John up with us. Yeah. As he had joined up with us back as manager. See, George was taking on a man at a time. Mm-hmm. Until he finally got the sixth voice in. Mm-hmm.
And I guess, uh, your first record was with Cuckoo. Yeah, that's right. Do you remember what was the first record tonight? First trumpet player was jazz, uh, Good Time Jazz. Good Time Jazz.
